readings.Aries: Something is beginning. You felt it before you understood it. Don't wait for the signal — you are the signal. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Taurus: Your threshold for chaos is lower than most people's. This is a feature, not a flaw. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Gemini: There are two kinds of curiosity — the kind that opens doors and the kind that avoids commitment. Know which you're using. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Cancer: Your intuition about what someone else is feeling is usually right. Your interpretation of why may not be. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Leo: Your radiance is not depleted by giving — it's amplified. Give more. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Virgo: You have a high tolerance for imperfection in others and almost none for it in yourself. Recalibrate. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Libra: The beauty you seek in your environment is also something you create in everyone around you. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Scorpio: Something you've been holding as a vulnerability is actually a source of power. Reframe it. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Sagittarius: You have more impact on people than your transience suggests. Take that seriously. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Capricorn: Your patience is a form of power. Today, deploy it on yourself. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Aquarius: Your vision requires infrastructure. You are good at the vision. The infrastructure needs attention today. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Pisces: There is a person in your life who is grounding and steadying and you take them for granted. Don't. Simpler is correct here.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
